dedupe_keys.name: suzhou industrial park building electricity loads

description: The SEMLab HFUT research team publishes smart-meter electricity loads from an industrial park in Suzhou, China. The public OSF description covers six years from 1 January 2016 to 31 December 2021 at 5-minute, 30-minute and hourly resolutions. Companion repository documentation identifies four buildings and describes converting daily XLSX files into analysis matrices. Separate electricity-load and weather ZIP archives are free on OSF under CC BY 4.0. These histories can calibrate building-load and demand-response simulations using model-energyplus or model-pypsa. A caveat is that one park cannot represent every industrial building or production schedule. The GitHub introduction says three years, but its table and the authoritative OSF description both specify six years and the same dates. Missing-value treatment can influence peaks and rare events, so users should examine processing choices. No load or weather archive was downloaded.
